description: This file defines classes and interfaces for safe, reference-counted access to file descriptors within the 'cuttlefish' namespace. It includes the implementation of SharedFD, WeakFD, ScopedMMap, and FileInstance classes, along with related functions for managing file descriptors, socket connections, and memory mappings. The file emphasizes safe resource management, lifetime awareness, and POSIX-like interface mimicry for file operations.

classes.name: SharedFD
classes.description: A reference-counted, safe wrapper around a file descriptor, providing POSIX-like interface and resource management.

classes.name: WeakFD
classes.description: A non-owning, weak reference to a SharedFD, allowing to lock and obtain a SharedFD if still valid.

classes.name: ScopedMMap
classes.description: A RAII wrapper for memory-mapped regions, ensuring proper cleanup.

classes.name: FileInstance
classes.description: Represents a file descriptor's lifetime, providing methods for file operations, connection management, and resource cleanup.

methods.name: SharedFD()
methods.description: Default constructor initializing to a closed file descriptor.

methods.name: SharedFD(const std::shared_ptr<FileInstance>& in)
methods.description: Constructs a SharedFD from a shared pointer to a FileInstance.

methods.name: Accept
methods.description: Creates a SharedFD by accepting a connection on a listening socket.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Opens a file and returns a SharedFD.

methods.name: Socket
methods.description: Creates a socket and returns a SharedFD.

methods.name: SocketLocalClient
methods.description: Creates a local client socket connection.

methods.name: operator==
methods.description: Equality comparison based on underlying FileInstance.
